property_mix.era: mixed interwar and post-war with Victorian pockets
property_mix.notable: Former industrial/mining heritage area with primarily residential conversion; high proportion of older door and lock systems requiring regular maintenance and upgrade.

locksmith_relevant: Interwar terraces and semis dominate; many feature original period locks needing specialist repair or period-appropriate replacement.
Post-war estates include diverse locking systems; UPVC and modern composite doors common in updated properties alongside older timber frames.
Rural character of Hammerwich and Woodhouses means customers often need rural/farm gate locks and security for period properties with heritage considerations.
